index_dir.description: Directory where Flatcurve stores index files. Must be writable by the dovecot user.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent database connections used by Flatcurve.

compression.description: Whether to compress index files. Reduces disk space but increases CPU usage during indexing.

strict_mode.description: Enforce strict consistency checks. Recommended for production to prevent index corruption.

skip_patterns.description: Mailbox name patterns to exclude from Flatcurve indexing (case-insensitive partial matches).

items.description: A mailbox pattern (e.g., 'Drafts' or '*Spam*') to skip during indexing.

db_settings.description: Key-value database engine configuration. Common options depend on backend (e.g., LMDB map size, SQLite journal mode).
